# Library positive-state native fixture

This is a separate0.4 mode of the shared two-client Library fixture. It retains the original two actual laboratory completions, native queue/cancellation/foreign-force assertions, ten client PNGs, six actual joins and saved-host restart. It imports only this fixture's `positive-state.lua` while control code is parsed. It imports no MIR implementation and accesses no MIR storage. Existing0.1/0.2/0.3 modes do not load these additional members.

The five-member player-test archive projects shared `library-multiplayer/control.lua` and `settings-updates.lua`, this directory's `data.lua` and `positive-state.lua`, and exactly one selected `info-f200.json` or `info-f210.json` as `info.json`. The wrapper's `New-LibraryPositiveFixtureSourceProjection` checks the target metadata and copies/hash-verifies precisely these five members. No developer README or alternate metadata enters the archive. The new profiles admit only exact current7b0 F200/1D45/D3 or F210 Base/2DDD/8DC, the existing observer, both independent API consumers and fixture0.4 at7168MiB. Space Age and imported-save inputs are not admitted by these new profiles.

During fresh `on_init` only, the fixture requires four zero-credit holders and zero native module/cannon contributions, then deliberately seeds holder levels2/3/4/5. A native effect reset must yield speed-module/productivity-module/efficiency-module productivity.01/.02/.03 and cannon-shell gun-speed.4. Every original native-state checkpoint and every stage marker checks those literal levels, flags and effects; the cold-host path never reseeds or derives replacement expectations from the candidate. This is labelled `fixture-seeded-disposable-world` with `imported_earnings=false` in every marker. It tests positive-state preservation and exclusion, not historical earning/import correctness.

The single added technology `mir5-fixture-foreign-hidden-research` belongs to the test fixture, has native `hidden=true`, no effects and ordinary enabled state. Both clients must inspect it in All and External. Native prototype hiding alone must not suppress foreign inspection. An explicit personal hidden list must exclude it in normal visibility and include it in hidden visibility. The four exact private credit IDs must remain absent with disabled native-open actions in both visibility choices. These44 post-restart matrix queries are in addition to the existing16 private-credit queries and their ordinary positive controls. No queue or native research action is synthesized.

Before saving the rejoined host, the English client receives the personal hidden list containing the foreign technology and the German client receives an empty list, while both original MIR queries/sorts remain visible. After the real cold-host restart, the first two foreign queries omit the `hidden` option: English must still exclude the foreign technology and German must still include it. Only then does the matrix replace either list. The original research/queue/effect snapshots and positive credit effects must survive all queries and restored personal views.

For F210 use the existing command below with canonical fixture directories; the governed wrapper projects the five-member fixture, observer and immutable API consumer members itself. For F200 use the same command with `library-positive-state-current-f200-2077.json`, the2.0.77/D3 binary, current1D45 hash and existing hash-verified F200 observer/API source projections. Supply the canonical shared Library template once; the wrapper replaces it with its own five-member F200 projection. Retain existing direct-library ownership, source/archive verification, admission, exact client assertions, clients-first teardown and restoration controls.

```powershell
$session = @{
  ArchiveLibrary = $ArchiveLibrary
  FactorioBin = $FactorioBin
  ProfilePath = 'tests/profiles/library-positive-state-standalone-f210-2123.json'
  FixtureSources = [string[]]@(
    'tests/fixtures/library-multiplayer'
    'tests/fixtures/active-mods-observer'
    'tests/fixtures/api-alpha'
    'tests/fixtures/api-beta'
  )
  ExpectedMIRArchiveSha256 = '2DDD2A4C967BEF07830218442AE4441BEECD5B9ECE0AC86B09A5F6586BBA80E5'
  OutputRoot = 'build/tmp/library-positive-state-f210-r01'
  FixtureCase = 'library-multiplayer'
  SessionExpectedPeakMemoryMiB = 7168
  RepoRoot = (Resolve-Path '.').Path
}
.\tools\Invoke-MultiplayerFixture.ps1 @session
```

Freeze the committed public helpers, all actual projected archive hashes and the private caller before Black Glass dispatches either run. This preparation contains no native result, timing or release verdict. Stop on any missing input, changed scalar, hidden-list mismatch, client/lifecycle failure, malformed readback or incomplete teardown; retain the original result and inputs. Never reseed after a failure, relax a credit assertion or report a different candidate as the tested input.

Actual historical earnings and a genuinely selected private row persisted by the predecessor remain separate obligations. Preserve/reuse protected source88FC and its completed F200029AA/F2108DCF successors from the accepted MIR1.1 route for the three module holders, and the accepted MIR1.2 routes for cannon credit. Their full independent preservation assertions and source-save hashes remain authoritative. Adding this fixture to a completed successor can invoke its configuration handler; diagnose and review that transition explicitly before dispatch, since the existing successor refuses a second begin. Do not bypass its assertions or reinterpret these deliberately seeded fresh states as imported saves. Native private-queue insertion, actual Esc/E/drag/focus, root retirement/player removal and retained/churn measurements are also separate.
